body: This is really really theme specific and should not go inside the default theme.
Could we use utf-8 in the default theme?
Anyway, as we are using scss and commiting the png files, we should use a mixin that does the base64 stuff for us.

> Anyway, as we are using scss and commiting the png files, we should use a mixin that does the base64 stuff for us.

Yes, I didn't find any "simple" mixin (I mean, without embedding the whole Compass/Bourbon; any idea?)

Yes I wasn't sure but at the end I was thinking: "OK, I want it to be usable without custom CSS (like all our widgets)". But indeed, maybe we could go for UTF-8 stars instead of images -> you would then be able to easily override the color.
Hmm, not on the top of my head but I'd be surprised we'd need a full Compass/Bourbon for that.
Can you move the usage to the new format we are using in other widgets?
